The chair is upright, all FOUR EQUAL uncut legs on the flat floor, the coral visitor now STANDING to the right beside that SAME ONE chair, with an appreciative smile and both feet on the floor. The SAME unused saw may rest safely on a high wall hook in the background; it must never touch the chair. Quiet joke: a big proposed operation was unnecessary; careful listening plus checking one tiny loose screw solved the real wobble. Do not ridicule the visitor.
